verification_signals: already present in our own production listings (2 rows from an earlier crawl)
accepted seller-filter query: no warnings, and all 20 sampled items returned username comc_consignment with no other username present
seller.filter_safety: every probe ran through assert_query_accepted; a rejected or silently dropped seller filter is a hard failure, never a result

total_plausibility.assessment: the seller total is a plausible subset of the category but is clearly saturated - identical across three different narrowings - so it is treated as an order-of-magnitude indicator, not a population count. The population cannot be enumerated: it exceeds the 10,000 offset cap by three orders of magnitude, so Phase 3 is a bounded stratified sample.

collection.method: Browse item_summary/search, sellers + buyingOptions:{FIXED_PRICE}, leaf 261328, 8 price bands x 2 pages x 200
collection.duplicate_explanation: offset paging over a very large, actively changing inventory returns some items on more than one page
collection.sampling_bias: each band was capped at 2 pages, so the sample reflects eBay's default ordering within each band and is not random

title_parser_coverage_over_B.finding: the COMC title format is YEAR SET [PARALLEL] [SERIAL] PLAYER #NUMBER PSA GRADE [FLAGS] CODE. The player name sits between the set and the card number with no delimiter, so the existing parser absorbs it into set_name - subject extraction is 0 of 254 and parse_status ok is 0 of 254.

aspect_coverage_over_30_getitem_psa_list.finding: every identity field the slab key needs is present and clean in localizedAspects on 30 of 30, so identity is fully resolvable through the project's existing Tier B enrichment path even though titles fail

comc_specific_risks.1_multiple_consignors_pricing_same_card: not observable through the eBay API; each eBay listing is a distinct item id with quantity 1, so separate consignor copies would appear as separate listings, which the cheapest-per-slab_key rule already handles
comc_specific_risks.2_one_listing_multiple_copies: no - estimatedAvailableQuantity is 1 on 30 of 30 and lotSize is 0 on 30 of 30
comc_specific_risks.3_resolves_to_a_specific_physical_slab: yes - quantity 1, no variations, distinct item id and image per listing
comc_specific_risks.4_simultaneous_listing_on_comc_com: not determinable without COMC.com access; see limitation below
comc_specific_risks.6_displayed_shipping_complete: yes - FIXED $4.99 on 3,052 of 3,052 collected and 30 of 30 getItem samples; acquisition_total is computable
comc_specific_risks.8_cheapest_per_slab_key_still_valid: yes, given quantity 1 and one physical slab per listing
comc_specific_risks.9_titles_omit_identity_fields: yes, materially - subject is absent from the parse on 100% of graded listings and only aspects recover it
comc_specific_risks.10_catalog_identifiers: epid present on 2,943 of 3,052 (96.4%), 2,926 distinct, 16 shared by more than one listing; and every title ends with a short alphanumeric COMC internal code on 3,052 of 3,052. Both are worth preserving if this seller is ever integrated.

comc_com_limitation: no authorized unauthenticated read-only project path to COMC.com exists, so risks 4 and 5 were not investigated and no COMC.com request was made. Reported as a limitation without changing scope.

eligibility_funnel.note: zero is a consequence of title-only identity resolution, not of the listings themselves: shipping, currency, format, quantity and category all pass on 100% of the sample

evidence_overlap.gate: exact effective full slab_key equality only; no Tier A, partial or fuzzy match was used for anything but the diagnostic line

decision_precondition: any pilot must first resolve identity through the existing Tier B aspect enrichment path. Title-only parsing yields zero usable identities on this seller, so a title-driven cohort is impossible. No reusable sold-comp evidence overlaps this seller, so a pilot would also require new Product Research.
